body:
## What

The guard half of #548, rebased onto main after the scrub (#553) and the validate-gate fixes (#552), with the four review round-3 fixes (ASK-2058). Diff is only the 5 guard files.

From #548, reviewed in rounds 1 to 3:
- Terms come from the private registries named in `~/.config/kipi/private-terms.json`, read at call time, not ten typed tokens.
- A merge scans only what no PUBLIC parent already carries.
- Binaries, zip members and path names are scanned.
- CI backstop `.github/workflows/private-terms.yml`: `pull_request_target`, base code only, an environment secret only main can use, full-tree scan when a push has no base, every pushed message scanned, exemptions pinned to a blob sha.
- lefthook pre-push refreshes the CI secret when the list changes.

## Round-3 fixes

Each one has a self-test case that fails against the #548 guard (8195ef89).

1. **`people` takes a list of keys** and a record or a list under each, so the registry's singular `contact` object is read. Case 22.
2. **`--sync-ci-secret` refuses to push when any configured source warns**, so a partial list never reaches CI looking complete. The commit scan keeps its WARN, so one moved registry does not freeze every commit. Case 23, plus a control that the secret IS pushed when every source reads.
3. **The BLOCK text and docstring claim names, people, emails and identifiers, not money.** The guard never matched amounts; a bare-rate matcher would fire on every price in this repo. Case 24.
4. **`+++ ` is a file header only between `diff --git` and the first `@@`**, so an added line starting with `++` is scanned. Case 25.

## Evidence

- `test-client-name-guard.py`: 52/52. Against the #548 guard: 6 FAIL, exactly cases 22 to 25 (the case-23 control passes on both).
- `verify.sh --changed`: ok.
- The 4 exemption pins in `.github/private-terms-exempt.txt` still match their blobs on main (31f44c2d).
- CI mode simulated with the exported payload and an empty HOME: range scan clean (1692 terms); full-tree scan clean (2837 files, 4 pinned-exempt).
- `test_ci_workflows.py`, `test_full_suite_doors.py`, `test_fleet_full_suite_scan.py`, `test-silent-success-lint.sh`: pass.

## After merge

- Set `"people": ["contacts", "contact"]` in the live `~/.config/kipi/private-terms.json`. The pre-fix guard would crash on a list, so this waits for the merge.
